answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware security-key attestation, and cap the total work weight any one attested device can carry per epoch. A sybil farmer can spin up a thousand software clones, but without a thousand distinct physical keys they all funnel through the same inlet of trust: the network sees one device, one cap, one share of influence, no matter how many faces it wears. Random re-attestation challenges keep the binding honest, like a crystal lattice that shows its flaws under violet light, so cloning costs real hardware per identity instead of free keystrokes.
